allowed_only_when: source snapshot is authoritative and hash-frozen
source snapshot was captured after the last exchange trading session before T0

no_change_interval_rule.semantics: The source bytes remain pre-T0 and are never relabeled as FORWARD_OBSERVED. The membership state is carried to T0 only because no membership-effective exchange trading interval exists.
forbidden: using this proof across any intervening exchange trading session
using this proof to backdate decisions before T0
using transport failure alone as proof of no change
